environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-sanitization' at priority 2 containing a RegexPatternSet rule matching request query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with action BLOCK and CloudWatch metric 'SQLiBlockCount', (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 3 with all rules in COUNT mode only (not blocking). Rate limiting rule at priority 0 blocks IPs exceeding 500 requests per 5 minutes. The WebACL default action is ALLOW.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, 0.5 vCPU, 1GB RAM, ephemeral storage only
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet, NAT gateway for egress
config.waf_rule_priority_1: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet, override all actions to COUNT
config.waf_rule_priority_2: Custom rule group 'corp-input-sanitization', RegexPatternSet on QueryString, pattern: (?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d), action BLOCK
config.waf_rule_priority_3: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, override all actions to COUNT
